name: openai/gpt-4o-2024-05-13
description: This is the pinned May 13, 2024 snapshot of OpenAI's GPT-4o, the original API release of the model, with text and image input and text output. It is intended for workloads that need a fixed, reproducible version of the launch-era GPT-4o rather than the moving GPT-4o alias. Later snapshots from August and November 2024 add Structured Outputs with JSON schemas and a larger output limit, so most fresh projects start with one of those.
